nodes.label: ROM Lockscreen Decoy Trigger (AOSP edition)
nodes.rationale: The xposed build hooks system_server to intercept the real lock screen; the aosp build has no hook available, so the ROM itself must perform the decoy-PIN check inside the platform, since Android blocks accessibility/other apps from reading the secure Keyguard PIN. This is the only way to read the PIN without Xposed.

nodes.label: Keyguard password-check patch
nodes.rationale: Keep the try/catch total so a bad or missing config file never bricks the lock screen; sender must hold MANAGE_USERS so a normal app can't spoof a decoy broadcast.
